fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN) is rated BUY with a $324 price target (approximately 26% upside versus current price of $257.06), with AWS revenue up 39% in Q3 and Google Cloud growing 103%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amazon's Q3 capital expenditure increased 120% to $77 billion, and CEO Andy Jassy noted that AWS could grow over 40% in 2027–2028 and could become a $1 trillion revenue business within the next 5–10 years.
